Game Overview

In Haton 2, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a thrilling platforming adventure in Haton 2. Navigate eight dynamic levels, dodging flying robots, spikes, and saws while collecting oranges. Master the critical double jump to conquer obstacles and reach the red flag, unlocking the next level's challenge. Keep your reflexes sharp for hidden dangers!
